keyFindings.description: openssh-client installs /usr/lib/openssh/ssh-keysign setuid root (mode 4755) and its postinst sets /usr/bin/ssh-agent 2755 group _ssh (read from the trixie deb). No exploit path in a pod: AllowPrivilegeEscalation=false and Drop ALL at internal/runtime/sandbox/manifest.go:886-887 ignore the bits. Hardening: `chmod u-s /usr/lib/openssh/ssh-keysign` in the same RUN; host-based authentication is never used.

The clause 'whether they reach anything is the deployment's NetworkPolicy, not the image's' (also docs/kubernetes.md:86) rests on a control this repository does not contain and omits the one isolation-relevant binary (ssh-keysign). The in-tree statement is that ssh/scp/sftp add no egress curl, wget, python3, node, bun and socat on the same apt line lack; the canonical networking statement is the withheld `network` row (capabilities.go:105, LEGION-5). Wording; fast-follow.

A subprocess's `jq` is now trixie's jq 1.7.1 while the bash tool's builtin stays the harness's jaq (docs/solutions/legion/worker-pane-shell-gotchas.md:505-536 records where they diverge); one sentence here would tell an agent that an expression verified in the tool shell runs a different engine in its script.
